high_level_description: The image is a screenshot of a news article from the Royal Holloway website, dated 16 July 2019. The article announces that Narayana Murthy was awarded an honorary degree of Doctor of Science (Honoris Causa) by Royal Holloway for his outstanding contribution to the field of Computer Science and the role model he represents in India and on the global stage. The text mentions that the ceremony took place at the university's campus in Egham, Surrey.
